question: The Ranjit Singh Gold Cup is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ranjit Singh Gold Cup is associated with the sport of **Hockey**.
 
• The tournament is named after **Maharaja Ranjit Singh**, a prominent historical figure in India.
 
• It is one of the prestigious tournaments in Indian hockey, attracting teams from various regions.
 
• The competition aims to promote and develop the sport of hockey within the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hockey has a rich history in India, with the country winning multiple Olympic gold medals in the sport.
 
• India's men's field hockey team won its** first Olympic gold medal in 1928** and dominated the sport for several decades.
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**, one of India's most celebrated athletes, is often associated with the** golden era of Indian hockey**.
 
• The Ranjit Singh Gold Cup continues to be an important event in the domestic hockey calendar, fostering young talent and keeping the legacy of the sport alive.
